assets.name: learn
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a small navigation illustration for an academic personal website, displayed at 80-100px wide on both warm off-white (#f6f3ee) and charcoal (#17181c) cards. Style: refined editorial miniature, matte folded paper and softly sculpted ceramic-like forms, a little dimensionality, clean gently rounded edges, restrained details. Palette: warm ivory, muted academic cobalt blue #2a4ea3, small ochre gold #d8a44a accents, subtle dark blue-grey edges for legibility. View: centered single object cluster, consistent three-quarter frontal view slightly from above. Square composition, subject occupies 78% of square with generous transparent padding, the whole object visible, crisp silhouette, high quality. Actual transparent alpha background: completely isolated cutout. No background, no floor, no colored rectangle or tile, no enclosing circle, no cast shadow outside object, no glow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark. Must be clear at small size, not photoreal, not glossy plastic, not a game reward.
Subject: one open book with clearly visible ivory pages and a muted cobalt blue cloth cover, a single ochre gold ribbon bookmark resting over the front page. A very small upright page tab is okay. Simple recognizable book silhouette; no writing or symbols on the pages.
